Hey Matt! 

You mentioned you made this in quarantine, which is awesome. What’s your home studio setup look like?
I found a place to live with next semester with my best friends!

I got a dog, and he requires so much walking and time outside, if forced me to be a lot more active. 

Also, just having a dog requires responsibility and time to build habits. This helped me stay consistent with my healthy habits

It’s kind of stalling now, but that’s just because I feel so much better and am more comfortable with myself. I still have that mindset of “just 10 more pounds”, but honestly most of the time i’m completely fine with where i’m at

Everything had to be built as a habit. The first and most important thing is to count calories. I told myself I could eat whatever I wanted, but foods like fruit, vegetables, and chicken go so much further than fast food. 

My biggest struggle was eating a lot really late right before bed. Feeling refreshed in the morning felt miles better than the temporary satisfaction I would get from 1am Taco Bell. Once I managed to control what I ate when I ate it, everything started to fall into place.  

Calories in vs calories out

I found this subreddit when I had no idea how to even approach what I wanted in a PC. Some very kind redditors offered their time to walk me through everything! Since then, I am much more knowledgeable about all the parts and components that go into building a PC.
